htmlBody:
Storage stacks still pay a parity tax and wait on lookup tables. Today’s tip is prime-indexed volumetric vaults under Φ ≈ 1.618 — catalog framing vs Reed-Solomon / LDPC / LBA, not a JEDEC silicon claim. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

If you want a map for that: Prime vaults for storage — ditch the parity tax (catalog). Also new on the board: Protein folding · prime vaults · Φ — catalog contrast to AlphaFold.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
